summary: HNO International filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with Monroe Street Capital Partners. The company issued a $67,500 convertible promissory note (with $5,000 OID) and a warrant to purchase 385,000 shares of common stock for gross proceeds of $62,500. Net proceeds after fees were ~$57,625. The note matures May 2027, bearing 8% interest, and is convertible at 60% of the lowest trading price over the prior 20 days. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event.
